properties.summary: Filed for public inspection at the Office of the Federal Register on 2026-11-09 at 13:45 UTC, to be published 2026-11-10. The filing's summary begins: "To allow for further discussion with China regarding the acts, policies, and practices at issue in this investigation, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) is modifying the action taken in this investigation to further suspend that action for two months, until January 10, 2027." Scheduled dates within 14 days after the filing: 2026-11-09 (the day it was filed; same investigation: a date its DATES paragraph names in document 2025-19873, published 2025-11-13). HW-IND-2's condition is met: a stay, suspension or extension by USTR, filed on the day of a date that document 2025-19873 (same investigation) set. Federal Register document 2026-22867.
properties.title: USTR notice filed for public inspection (2026-11-09): Section 301 Action: China's Targeting of the Maritime, Logistics, and Shipbuilding Sectors for Dominance; Modification

properties.summary: Filed for public inspection at the Office of the Federal Register on 2026-11-09 at 13:45 UTC, to be published 2026-11-10. The filing's summary begins: "The United States Trade Representative (Trade Representative) has determined to extend for three months the ongoing Section 301 investigation of certain acts, policies, and practices of the Government of Vietnam related to intellectual property (IP) protection and enforcement." Docket USTR-2026-0364. HW-IND-2's condition is not met: no date of the same rule, docket or investigation falls within 14 days after it, and the filing names none as scheduled. Federal Register document 2026-22868.

properties.summary: Filed for public inspection at the Office of the Federal Register on 2026-11-09 at 13:45 UTC, to be published 2026-11-10. The filing's summary begins: "In prior notices, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) modified the actions in the Section 301 investigation of China’s acts, policies, and practices related to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation by excluding from additional duties certain products of China." Scheduled dates within 14 days after the filing: 2026-11-09 (the day it was filed; same investigation: a date its DATES paragraph names in document 2025-21671, published 2025-12-01). HW-IND-2's condition is met: a stay, suspension or extension by USTR, filed on the day of a date that document 2025-21671 (same investigation) set. Federal Register document 2026-22925.
